task_definition.task_description: Please search the electronics catalog for headphones and reserve one Sony XM5 Black (p_sony_xm5_blk) for me (user_01). Next, build my cart with this item, check my available coupons, apply the best discount, and generate a Stripe payment invoice for alice@company.com. After that, check Alice's calendar availability starting November 1, 2024. Then, scan for smart devices in the living room, select the smart lock from the results, and lock it. Finally, send an email alert to Alice with the generated invoice message, and create a document titled "Transaction and Security Log" recording the notification status.

Then, scan for smart devices in the living_room, select the smart lock (lock_main) from the results, and lock it. Finally, send an email alert to Alice with the generated invoice message, and create a document titled "Transaction and Security Log" to record the notification status.
